package e2e

// Redis 不可用（方案 §5“Redis 不可用时的退化”、KNOWN-LIMITS 路由边界 ②）：两个 alliance 实例与调用方都经 toxiproxy 的
// redis 代理连 Redis，断开代理（Redis 本身不动）期间路由 RPC 回退读所有权记录，量一次 Mongo 点读放大；断开期间把路由
// 登记删掉（模拟 Redis 丢键），恢复后续期答“不存在”触发重新登记。最后断开超过单实例锁的续期期限，记下进程的处理
// （单实例锁同样连这个 Redis：App 失锁即 fail-stop，见 framework/app 单实例锁）。
//
// 短断开必须短于单实例锁扛得住的时长，而且有确定的余量（见 shortOutageLimit）：短断开由 redisOutage 执行，断开期间的
// 步骤带截止时间，做完立即恢复并断言实际断开时长，恢复后等两个实例的锁重新续上。

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	coreremote "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/remoteentity"
)

// infoRound 用新建的客户端（空路由缓存）依次读每个联盟 rounds 遍，返回调用数、失败数、所有权点读数与延迟。
func (s *suite) infoRound(lookup lookupResolver, owners *countingOwners, alliances []int64, d time.Duration) (calls, failed int, reads int64, lat []time.Duration) {
	before := owners.reads.Load()
	end := time.Now().Add(d)
	for time.Now().Before(end) {
		for _, id := range alliances {
			client := s.client(lookup, 3*time.Second)
			start := time.Now()
			_, err := client.Info(s.ctx, target(s.t, id))
			lat = append(lat, time.Since(start))
			calls++
			if err != nil {
				failed++
			}
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(lat, func(i, j int) bool { return lat[i] < lat[j] })
	return calls, failed, owners.reads.Load() - before, lat
}

// 单实例锁的时间参数：用例显式写进两个 alliance 实例的配置，短断开的上限由它们算出。ttl 用 30s 而不是缺省 15s：
// 缺省参数下对任意相位只扛得住 9s，减去驱动恢复与余量只剩 6s，而断开期间的 info 轮、入会 / 退会 / 跨实例入会合起来
// 本机要 8～10s（每次断开开头，各进程的 go-redis 连接池每个请求先拨号重试 5 次、约 0.4s），拆成几次断开也各要 2.5～6s，
// 放不进 6s。缺省参数下锁在哪一拍失锁由 framework/app 的 TestSingletonSurvivesAStoreOutageOnlyUntilTheLastChanceBeat 钉住，
// 这里只验证路由在 Redis 断开期间的退化，所以给锁足够的余量；长断开那段记下这组参数下的 fail-stop。
const (
	lockTTL   = 30 * time.Second
	lockGuard = 5 * time.Second
	lockRenew = 3 * time.Second
)

// shortOutageLimit 是短断开的上限：单实例锁对任意节拍相位都扛得住的断开，减去 go-redis 恢复的延迟，再留余量。
//   - 续期节拍是上一次 Applied 的 asked（T）+ k × renew_interval，回复不早于 T + ttl − guard 的失败判失锁。toxiproxy 关代理时
//     拨号立即被拒，最后一次能挽回的是 T 之后第一个不早于 T + ttl − guard 的节拍（这组参数 T+27s，缺省参数 T+12s）；断开可能
//     在 T 之后将近一个 renew_interval 才开始，所以对任意相位都扛得住的只有 (⌈(ttl−guard)/renew⌉ − 1) × renew（24s；缺省 9s，
//     不是 ttl − guard）。
//   - go-redis 连接池连续 PoolSize 次拨号失败后不再拨号、直接返回上次的错误，由后台每秒探测一次；锁客户端 PoolSize 2，
//     断开两拍后就进入这个状态，Redis 恢复后续期最多还要失败约 1s（本机实测 1.02s）。
//   - 余下 2s 给本机负载下节拍与回复的延迟（节拍晚到、失败回复越过 T + ttl − guard 都会提前失锁）。
//
// 原用例用缺省参数、断开时长没有上限（注释写 6s，本机实测 8～9.4s，入会重试慢时更长），越过了缺省参数的 9s − 1s：最后一拍
// 仍落在断开里或拨号退避里的那个实例失锁，用例报“4 of 8 missing”或断开期间的入会 no responders。
func shortOutageLimit() time.Duration {
	lastChance := (lockTTL - lockGuard + lockRenew - 1) / lockRenew * lockRenew
	const driverRecovery, margin = time.Second, 2 * time.Second
	return lastChance - lockRenew - driverRecovery - margin
}

// lockOptions 把单实例锁的时间参数写进进程配置。
func lockOptions(redis string) procOptions {
	return procOptions{redis: redis, keys: [][3]string{
		{"singleton", "ttl", lockTTL.String()},
		{"singleton", "guard", lockGuard.String()},
		{"singleton", "renew_interval", lockRenew.String()},
		{"singleton", "startup_wait", (2 * lockTTL).String()}, // App 要求 ≥ ttl + 2 × renew_interval
	}}
}

// redisOutage 断开 redis 代理执行 steps：steps 拿到截止在 shortOutageLimit 的 ctx，返回后立即恢复代理，并断言实际断开时长
// 不超过上限、steps 在截止前做完（没做完说明本机太慢，报出来而不是让锁的余量被吃掉）。恢复后等 procs 的单实例锁都重新
// 续上（/readyz 的 singleton 为 ok）。
func (s *suite) redisOutage(what string, procs []*proc, steps func(ctx context.Context)) (restored time.Time) {
	t := s.t
	t.Helper()
	limit := shortOutageLimit()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(s.ctx, limit)
	defer cancel()
	s.toxiproxyRedis(false)
	down := time.Now()
	steps(ctx)
	stepsErr := ctx.Err()
	s.toxiproxyRedis(true)
	restored = time.Now()
	outage := restored.Sub(down)
	t.Logf("REDIS outage (%s): %v (limit %v)", what, outage.Round(time.Millisecond), limit)
	if stepsErr != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s did not finish within the %v outage limit (the machine is too slow for this step; the limit keeps the singleton lock's margin)", what, limit)
	}
	if outage > limit+time.Second {
		t.Fatalf("%s kept Redis down for %v, more than the %v limit", what, outage.Round(time.Millisecond), limit)
	}
	for _, p := range procs {
		if !s.alive(p) {
			t.Fatalf("%s stopped during a %v Redis outage (limit %v)", p.name, outage.Round(time.Millisecond), limit)
		}
	}
	s.eventually(what+": every singleton lock renewed after the outage", 4*lockRenew, func() (bool, string) {
		for _, p := range procs {
			if state := singletonHealth(p); state != "ok" {
				return false, fmt.Sprintf("%s singleton %s", p.name, state)
			}
		}
		return true, ""
	})
	return restored
}

// definiteBy 是截止到 ctx 的 definite：断开期间的步骤不越过断开上限（ctx 到期时返回最后一次的错误）。
func definiteBy(ctx context.Context, call func(context.Context) error) (error, int) {
	deadline, _ := ctx.Deadline()
	return definite(ctx, time.Until(deadline), call)
}

// singletonHealth 读进程 /readyz 里 singleton 检查的状态（ok / degraded / fail；读不到为空）。
func singletonHealth(p *proc) string {
	resp, err := http.Get("http://" + p.ops + "/readyz")
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	var body struct {
		Dependencies []struct {
			Name   string `json:"name"`
			Status string `json:"status"`
		} `json:"dependencies"`
	}
	if json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&body) != nil {
		return ""
	}
	for _, dep := range body.Dependencies {
		if dep.Name == "singleton" {
			return dep.Status
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func TestAllianceE2ERedisOutage(t *testing.T) {
	s := newSuite(t, 15*time.Minute)
	if s.proxiedRedis == "" {
		t.Skip("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_REDIS_PROXIED_ADDR not set")
	}
	s.toxiproxyRedis(true)
	t.Cleanup(func() { s.toxiproxyRedis(true) })
	opts := lockOptions(s.proxiedRedis)
	a := s.start("alliance-3000", "alliance", 3000, opts)
	b := s.start("alliance-3001", "alliance", 3001, opts)
	_, proxiedLookup, owners := s.newLookup(s.proxiedRedis)
	resolver := lookupResolver{proxiedLookup}
	client := s.client(resolver, 3*time.Second)
	leader := int64(800_000)
	var alliances []int64
	alliances = append(alliances, s.foundOn(client, 3000, 4, &leader)...)
	alliances = append(alliances, s.foundOn(client, 3001, 4, &leader)...)

	calls, failed, reads, lat := s.infoRound(resolver, owners, alliances, 3*time.Second)
	t.Logf("REDIS up: %d info calls (fresh route cache each), %d failed, %d ownership reads (%.2f per call), p50 %v p99 %v",
		calls, failed, reads, float64(reads)/float64(calls), percentile(lat, .5), percentile(lat, .99))
	if failed != 0 || reads != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("with Redis up: %d failed, %d ownership reads; want 0 and 0", failed, reads)
	}

	// 短断开：路由 RPC 照常答，每次缓存未命中多一次 Mongo 点读；断开期间入会 / 退会与跨实例入会（守卫在 3000、联盟在 3001，
	// 实例之间的路由 RPC 也回退所有权记录）；最后直接在 Redis 上删掉全部联盟的登记（模拟丢键），恢复后由续期重新登记。
	player := int64(810_000)
	var keys []string
	for _, id := range alliances {
		keys = append(keys, coreremote.RouteKey(s.prefix, target(t, id)))
	}
	restored := s.redisOutage("short outage", []*proc{a, b}, func(ctx context.Context) {
		calls, failed, reads, lat = s.infoRound(resolver, owners, alliances, 4*time.Second)
		t.Logf("REDIS down: %d info calls, %d failed, %d ownership reads (%.2f per call), p50 %v p99 %v",
			calls, failed, reads, float64(reads)/float64(calls), percentile(lat, .5), percentile(lat, .99))
		if failed != 0 || reads != int64(calls) {
			t.Fatalf("with Redis down: %d of %d failed, %d ownership reads; want 0 failures and one read per call", failed, calls, reads)
		}
		if err, _ := definiteBy(ctx, func(ctx context.Context) error {
			_, err := client.Join(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("j-%d", player), player, 1000, target(t, alliances[0]))
			return err
		}); err != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err, _ := definiteBy(ctx, func(ctx context.Context) error {
			_, err := client.Leave(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("l-%d", player), player, 1000, target(t, alliances[0]))
			return err
		}); err != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err, _ := definiteBy(ctx, func(ctx context.Context) error {
			_, err := client.Join(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("j2-%d", player), player, 1000, target(t, alliances[4]))
			return err
		}); err != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
			t.Fatalf("cross-instance join with Redis down: %v", err)
		}
		s.redis.Del(ctx, keys...)
	})
	s.eventually("the renewal finds the lost registrations and registers them again", 40*time.Second, func() (bool, string) {
		missing := 0
		for _, id := range alliances {
			if s.routeValue(target(t, id)) == "" {
				missing++
			}
		}
		return missing == 0, fmt.Sprintf("%d of %d missing", missing, len(alliances))
	})
	t.Logf("REDIS registrations back %v after Redis returned", time.Since(restored).Round(time.Millisecond))
	g, err := client.Guard(s.ctx, guard(t, player))
	if err != nil || g.State.AllianceID != alliances[4] || g.State.PendingRequestID != "" {
		t.Fatalf("guard after the outage: %+v %v", g.State, err)
	}

	// 长断开：超过单实例锁扛得住的时长（这组参数下断开开始后 24～27s 失锁，见 shortOutageLimit），记下实例怎么处理。
	s.toxiproxyRedis(false)
	long := time.Now()
	var stoppedAfter []string
	deadline := time.Now().Add(lockTTL + 15*time.Second)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) && (s.alive(a) || s.alive(b)) {
		time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	for _, p := range []*proc{a, b} {
		if s.alive(p) {
			stoppedAfter = append(stoppedAfter, fmt.Sprintf("%s still running", p.name))
		} else {
			stoppedAfter = append(stoppedAfter, fmt.Sprintf("%s exited (%v)", p.name, p.exitErr))
		}
	}
	t.Logf("REDIS long outage: after %v: %s", time.Since(long).Round(time.Second), strings.Join(stoppedAfter, "; "))
	s.toxiproxyRedis(true)
	for _, p := range []*proc{a, b} {
		if !s.alive(p) {
			s.launch(p)
			s.waitReady(p, 2*time.Minute)
		}
	}
	for _, id := range alliances {
		err, _ := definite(s.ctx, time.Minute, func(ctx context.Context) error {
			_, err := s.client(resolver, 3*time.Second).Info(ctx, target(t, id))
			return err
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("alliance %d after the long outage: %v", id, err)
		}
	}
}
